title: Library Management System
description: A console-based Java Library Management System for managing books, members, borrowing, returning, and searching operations using object-oriented programming and ArrayList collections.

title: Student Management System
description: A console-based Java Student Management System for adding, viewing, searching, updating, and deleting student records using object-oriented programming and ArrayList collections.

title: World Atlas
description: Built an interactive world atlas covering 195+ countries with live country data fetched via REST APIs. Implemented client-side routing with React Router and integrated Axios for efficient, reusable data fetching.
